scope.frontend: State scanner isolates GCC [path:line:column] annotations, comments, strings and complete multiline asm; retain raw SHA, original ranges and coordinates. D.123/cpu.358_1 are whole GIMPLE identifiers, not dot fields; file paths/strings/asm cannot create field events. Unsupported spans remain opaque and visible, malformed input insufficient rather than deleted.
scope.events: Function/declarations, scalar assignment/copy/cast/pure operations, explicit pointer-member load/store, indexed load if exact shape known, calls/results, labels, conditional target pair/unconditional goto, return, scopes/try/finally/clobber/opaque. No CPU/rq/core/field/function names hardcoded in implementation. Output partial fact graph, never whole-function proof from supported snippets.
scope.local_dependencies: Version scalar defs in supported straight-line region; bind uses only same-region visible defs, explicit unresolved live-ins. Cast is syntactic dependency, not value equivalence. Reset environment at label, branch/goto/return, opaque, asm, call, memory write, scope/try/finally. Call arguments may use earlier local defs, but call result unknown; may start result definition in new region. No last-text-definition inference across join/backedge/effects; memory loads are source events not proof of alias/object sameness.
scope.control: Record exact displayed explicit goto targets bound to labels; adjacency only candidate, not proven reachability or guaranteed call/asm return. Do not flatten try/finally into proven CFG; diagnostic/asm not automatically return.
scope.queries: Select generic facts by event kind/source coordinate/node and dependency links, no caller expected roles/CPU mapping/helper effect. Search witness vs all-members, store dominance and globally first real content consumption stay unsupported absent full evidence.
scope.output: Raw/binding identities, complete statement ranges/raw and normalized views, events/local chains, explicit target candidates, barriers, coverage/unknowns. Machine facts separate from source interpretations.

roles.n2_selector: Implement new gimple_local_flow.py/tests; no new reference expected checks before root method freeze; old frozen code unchanged.
roles.arch_check_review: Independently prepare and freeze finite source-truth query checks on existing fragments without reading new method/tests/output; disclose after method freeze. Source-fidelity developer evidence, not human gold.
roles.authority_audit: Pre-freeze scope/scanner/version/barrier review without reference checks; postfreeze fidelity and contribution audit.
roles.root: Bind inputs, adapters, freeze, once-only analyze both fragments, compare source-truth query checks without feeding expected into method, report and sync notes.

evaluation.development: Meaningful path/asm/GIMPLE-name scanning, alias/redefinition/cast and branch/call/write/asm/structured barrier tests. Component snippets not Linux cases or native runtime.
evaluation.actual: Both full exact real fragments; report source/statement coverage, supported local facts vs unknowns, false support separately. Reference checks independent role, all already-known source development not accuracy/generalization.
evaluation.freeze: Method/adapters before reference-check disclosure and actual outcomes; no post-outcome fixes/input rewrites to chase checks. Preserve old N2.9/10/11.
evaluation.claims: No bug count or formal Linux independent denominator from event/edge/query counts. No contract from syntactic graph.

exit: Bounded reusable protocol+implementation, developer tests, real program output, independent source comparison/audit and Windows/WSL notes; no helper tree or ordinary-C v3.
